Covid-19 has shown that telemedicine is critical for patient access to health care. Alongside @RepCindyAxne, I am proud to introduce the Telehealth Extension and Evaluation Act to ensure coverage of this service is extended for an additional two years. 

https://t.co/0neA6ROEdz

As a member of @GOPLeader's Healthy Future Task Force (HFTF), I'm glad my bill, the Medicare Multi-Cancer Early Detection Screening Coverage Act, is included as one of its key initiatives. The HFTF will work to improve healthcare quality and access for all Americans!

I’m honored to be among @preventcancer’s Cancer Champions for bipartisan work advancing the Multi-Cancer Early Detection Screening Coverage Act.

This bill will increase access to lifesaving screenings and we must get it across the finish line. #preventcancergala

During #ChildhoodCancerAwarenessMonth we renew our dedication to ending this terrible disease. Measures like my Medicare Multi-Cancer Early Detection Screening Coverage Act will go a long way in the fight to end cancer, but we can't stop there. #GoGold

Stopping cancer starts with early detection. That’s why we must pass the Medicare Multi-Cancer Early Detection Screening Coverage Act to increase access to these live-saving tests. Read more:
https://t.co/XZhrD3ouMT

The bipartisan Medicare Multi-Cancer Early Detection Screening Coverage Act is critical in the fight to end cancer.

I joined @RepArrington, @RepRaulRuizMD, & @RepTerriSewell in leading our colleagues urging a vote before the calendar year ends.

https://t.co/s3puc404vr

New research from @NORCNews finds just 1 in 7 cancer cases are diagnosed through screening. Our bipartisan Medicare Multi-Cancer Early Detection Screening Coverage Act would give seniors access to new #MCED screening technologies without undue delay.

https://t.co/ztZWstY7gT

Clinical laboratories play a crucial role in saving patients' lives. I'm proud to help lead bipartisan legislation to protect American seniors' access to lab services and testing that are threatened by Medicare payment cuts. 

Read more: https://t.co/1H1Z229d3R

Too many families are devastated by a cancer diagnosis every day in the United States. By increasing access to multi-cancer early detection screening tests through Medicare, we can detect cancers sooner and save lives.

Read more: https://t.co/zEmZ4J2Sdf

As the @HouseGOP leader on pandemic preparedness legislation, I am proud to introduce the Medical and Health Stockpile Accountability Act, bipartisan legislation to ensure medical providers have the resources they need to help their patients.

Details: https://t.co/RX2qyqGHZh

While we celebrate the incredible advances of cancer research, there’s still work to be done.

That’s why last year I reintroduced the Nancy Gardner Sewell Medicare MCED Screening Coverage Act, which would detect cancers sooner & save lives in NC & across the U.S. #WorldCancerDay

✅ @HouseGOP just passed legislation to prevent Big Bureaucracy from dictating patients’ access to lifesaving treatment. 

Every American, especially our most vulnerable, deserves to receive the quality care they need.

We’re fighting to ensure they get it.

Families impacted by rare diseases often face unimaginable challenges in getting the treatment they need.

That's why I’m proud to reintroduce a resolution recognizing Rare Disease Day, which raises awareness & supports those in NC & across the U.S. battling rare diseases.
Thanks to @FujifilmDiosyn for the big investment in our state, which will create good-paying jobs for North Carolinians & produce groundbreaking medicines for folks in need treatment!

The law that gave hope to veterans harmed by medical negligence has been outright ignored by the DoD. 

It’s infuriating & unacceptable. 

My bill will help ensure these victims, like Lauren Palladini & Dez Del Barba, can receive the justice they deserve. https://t.co/jiQI4kroyI

This #SuicidePreventionMonth, let’s remind ourselves that simply reaching out can save a life. As a Member on the Health Subcommittee, I’m proud to support groups like @988Lifeline to provide hope and help to Americans — especially veterans — struggling with mental health crises.

Last night, nearly 80 House Democrats voted to allow CCP-linked companies steal Americans’ health data and infiltrate our economy. 

They’d rather protect our adversaries over our national security.

VP Harris and Gov. Walz’s Big Government healthcare policies leave patients with fewer, lower quality choices and higher costs.

Conservatives offer a better path that puts patients FIRST.

Read more in my op-ed with @Heritage’s Nina Owcharenko Schaefer https://t.co/IjKkQe4OFt

A new damning report by @HouseCommerce reveals that HHS spent $911 MILLION of your tax dollars to promote lies about the COVID vaccine and the virus’s risk to kids.

Americans have lost trust in our public health system because of the Harris-Biden admin.

This National Rural Health Day, we recognize the resilience of our rural communities and the dedication of healthcare providers who ensure care reaches every corner.

In Congress, I will always support our rural health heroes making a difference every single day!
Thank you, President @realDonaldTrump! Looking forward to working with you to get this done and ensure patients are put FIRST!

Liberal states like California are STILL trying to pay for illegals’ health care costs at the expense of hardworking taxpayers. 

Not only is this against the law, but it further incentivizes MORE illegal crossings. 

My Protect Medicaid Act would put a stop to it.

Too often, families in North Carolina and across the country are devastated by a cancer diagnosis.

My bill with @RepArrington and @RepTerriSewell will increase access to breakthrough cancer screenings so we can catch cancers sooner and save lives.

Congratulations to our new Secretary of Health and Human Services, RFK Jr.!

Let’s Make America Healthy Again!

🚨President Trump will sign an Executive Order to CANCEL any federal benefits, like health care, going to illegals.

No more rewarding those who break our laws on American taxpayers’ dime.

Congress should follow suit and codify this into law by passing my Protect Medicaid Act.
